progress_summary: The PR documentation packet is current for the sealed v1.8.3 tag baseline. Product runbooks, release governance, changelog, and release/git skill contracts now describe the signed local pre-push gate, exact remote tag-object verification, and the versioned seal that binds the release tag to the hardened publisher workflow and MCP registry payload. No documentation follow-up is required for this focused fix.

key_decisions: A catalog version alone cannot identify the hardened release baseline because unsafe ancestors can already claim the same version.
release-seal.json binds the approved catalog generation to the exact publisher workflow and server.json payload by SHA-256.
Operators verify the signed tag locally before push; the production gate then requires the identical raw tag object and peeled commit on origin.
The PR body carries the mandatory Documentation section inline; no PR comment is needed.
